photos.desc: Fossil of Sordes, an extinct reptile- Took the picture at Dinosaurium, Prague
The skeleton cast of campainha Sordes pilosus Sharov. Late Jurassic. Found in Kazakhstan. Is in the Paleontological Museum named after Y. A. Orlov of Russian Academy of Sciences (Moscow)
